description: This file defines the API endpoints for managing 'likes' on comments within the 'Buzz' feature of the OrangeHRM system. It includes operations for listing likes, liking a comment, and unliking a comment, with input validation, transaction handling, and Swagger/OpenAPI annotations for documentation.

classes.name: BuzzLikeOnCommentAPI
classes.description: API class for managing likes on comments within the Buzz module, providing endpoints for listing, liking, and unliking comments.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of likes on a specific comment, with support for sorting and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new like on a specified comment, handling transactions and validation.

methods.name: setBuzzLikeOnComment
methods.description: Sets the properties of a BuzzLikeOnComment entity before saving.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes a like from a comment, updating the like count and handling transactions.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for listing likes.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for liking a comment.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Returns validation rules for unliking a comment.
